title: Inter's Derby Matters More Than a 2031 Stadium | Lautaro Among 5 Papers Rule Out
description:
Inter's derby matters more than a 2031 stadium — and the papers say Lautaro Martínez will not be playing in it.
https://www.nerazzurridaily.com/go/yt/?ed=59

Blue means the club said it. Pink means only the papers did.

CONFIRMED · Inter.it (Oct 29) — Inter and AC Milan unveiled the Generali Stadium at the Castello Sforzesco: 71,500 seats, construction from 2028, first match targeted for 2031/32.
CONFIRMED · Inter.it / World Soccer Talk (Oct 30) — AC Milan host Inter at San Siro on Saturday, Oct 31: 3:45 PM ET, 20:45 CET, on Paramount+ and Telemundo.
REPORTED · Corriere dello Sport (Oct 30) — Lautaro Martínez, Benjamin Pavard, John Stones, Curtis Jones and Luis Henrique all ruled out of the derby. Inter have published no team news.
REPORTED · Calcio e Finanza via FCInterNews (Oct 29) — Generali's naming rights put at €650 million over 25 years, about €26 million a season.
